Description: End-to-end Source to Landing to Bronze to Silver to Gold flow controlled by CNFG metadata and tracked through AUDT.

Summary: Extracts configured source entities and writes Landing data
Description: Master orchestration pipeline for the AbilityOne metadata-driven ETL process. Retrieves active ConfigId definitions, manages BatchId and RunId context, and invokes the Landing, Bronze, Silver, and Gold layer pipelines in the required execution sequence.

Summary: Processes persisted Landing data for downstream Bronze ingestion
Description: Represents the existing Landing-stage pipeline in the Fabric orchestration.

Summary: Loads Landing data into Bronze Delta tables
Description: Reads Landing output, adds Bronze metadata, skips existing BatchId, and appends to Bronze with schema evolution.

Summary: Transforms Bronze data into Silver SCD1 Delta tables
Description: Filters by Bronze BatchId, validates primary keys, rejects invalid records, deduplicates, applies optional CNFG column mapping, and performs SCD1 merge.

Summary: Loads Silver data through Gold CDC staging into Warehouse targets
Description: Loads WH_EDWDATALAKE CDC staging, captures metrics, updates audit, and advances the Gold watermark with retry logic.

Summary: Merges Gold CDC staging tables into final WH_EDWDATALAKE dbo targets
Description: Executes dbo.usp_Merge_CDCGold_To_Dbo for active CNFG.ETL_GoldObject rows and moves data from WH_EDWDATALAKE.CDC staging tables into final WH_EDWDATALAKE.dbo tables.
